statement.p: Find the gradient of the function f(x,y,z) = xe^{\frac{y}{4}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(z\right).

static.solution: f_x = e^{\frac{y}{4}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(z\right), f_y = x\cdot 0.25e^{\frac{y}{4}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(z\right), and f_z = xe^{\frac{y}{4}}\cos\mathopen{}\left(z\right). Thus \mbox{grad} f = e^{\frac{y}{4}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(z\right)\,\mathit{\vec i}+x\cdot 0.25e^{\frac{y}{4}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(z\right)\,\mathit{\vec j}+xe^{\frac{y}{4}}\cos\mathopen{}\left(z\right)\,\mathit{\vec k}.
